name: Account added to a privileged group
purpose: Surface unexpected privilege changes while ignoring approved automation accounts.
description: Matches privilege-group membership additions. Approved change accounts are excluded explicitly so the exclusion is visible and reviewable.

attack.justification: Adding an account to a privileged group is the observable action of Account Manipulation.

playbook.what: {username} added an account to a privileged group on {host}.
playbook.why: Privileged group membership grants broad control. Unplanned additions are a common step after an account is taken over.
playbook.howSure: Medium. The event itself is certain; whether it was authorized is not known from telemetry alone.
next: Check whether a change ticket or approved maintenance covers this change.
Review what {username} did before the change.
Confirm the added member's identity and whether they need the access.
verify: The change is either linked to an approval or reverted.
Group membership on {host} matches the expected list.
alternatives: Planned administration by a person not on the exclusion list.
Provisioning automation that should be added to the approved list.
